candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance increment so it assigns instead of adds, making balances[msg.sender] = msg.value rather than increasing it.
Remove the overflow check require so Deposit no longer guards against overflow when updating balances.
Insert an extra addition to double-count msg.value so balances increment by twice the deposited amount.
Replace the call to Log.AddMessage with an early return before logging, so Deposit updates balance but does not log.
Move the require check to after updating balances, allowing potential reverts only after state change (changing observed balances on revert behavior).
